Text: Common sertraline side effects:
The most common sertraline side effects are nausea, diarrhea or loose stools.
They include trouble sleeping, dry mouth, tiredness, dizziness, and sleepiness.
Other common side effects are tremor, indigestion, agitation, reduced appetite, increased sweating, and sexual problems.
The table below shows how often each side effect was reported.
The data comes from pooled placebo-controlled trials.
The trials included 3,066 adults.
The trials included 2,293 people taking placebo.
Side effect | Sertraline | Placebo
Nausea | 26% | 12%
Diarrhea or loose stools | 20% | 10%
Insomnia (trouble sleeping) | 20% | 13%
Dry mouth | 14% | 9%
Fatigue (tiredness) | 12% | 8%
Dizziness | 12% | 8%
Somnolence (sleepiness) | 11% | 6%
Tremor (shaking) | 9% | 2%
Dyspepsia (indigestion) | 8% | 4%
Agitation | 8% | 5%
Decreased appetite | 7% | 2%
Hyperhidrosis (heavy sweating) | 7% | 3%
Constipation | 6% | 4%
Decreased libido (lower sex drive) | 6% | 2%
Palpitations | 4% | 2%
Visual impairment | 4% | 2%
Vomiting | 4% | 1%
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has side effect frequency data from", "pooled placebo-controlled trials"]

The relation 'has side effect frequency data from' in the triplet is defined as 'The frequency data for the subject drug's adverse effect is derived from the study or population specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
C. 'has administration frequency': The subject drug or regimen is taken at the frequency specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect location': The adverse effect caused by the subject drug occurs at the location specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
